messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The EC tells the INQ about the change of his master data. The INQ notifies the IP of the change. The IP checks whether the master data can be changed at the desired time. The IP confirmes the changes of the INQ or the IP rejectes the changes of the INQ.

response.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="MasterDataChangeProcess" name="Master Data Change Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="EC notifies INQ">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="Changes Confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_2" name="Changes Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_1" name="INQ notifies IP of change">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_2" name="IP checks feasibility at desired time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_1" name="Decision Gateway">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_1" targetRef="Task_2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_2" targetRef="Gateway_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" name="Confirm" sourceRef="Gateway_1" targetRef="EndEvent_1">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">confirmed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" name="Reject" sourceRef="Gateway_1" targetRef="EndEvent_2">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">rejected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
